bull.q: What underpins the volume growth outlook?
bull.a: Capacity additions and high plant load factors are the core upside lever cited by brokers.

bear.q: What is the single biggest downside risk?
bear.a: Merchant-tariff and fuel-cost volatility is flagged as the main risk to earnings.

debates.q: Is the current valuation justified by the growth runway?
debates.a: Brokers differ on whether the re-rating already prices in the capacity pipeline.
